Mississippi State Senate
2024 Regular Session
YEAS AND NAYS. The yeas and nays being taken, the Report of Conference
Committee on H. B. No. 1988 (version 2) failed to be adopted, a three-fifths vote being
required:
Yeas--Berry, Blackwell, Branning, DeBar, DeLano, England, Fillingane, Harkins,
Johnson, Kirby, McCaughn, Michel, Rhodes, Robinson, Seymour, Sparks, Suber,
Whaley, Wiggins, Williams, Younger. Total--21.
Nays--Blackmon, Blount, Brumfield, Bryan, Frazier, Hickman, Hopson, Jackson,
Jordan, McLendon, Norwood, Simmons D. T. (12th), Simmons S. (13th), Thomas,
Thompson, Turner-Ford. Total--16.
Absent and those not voting--Barnett, Barrett, Carter, Chassaniol, Chism, Hill,
Ladner, Parks, Tate. Total--9.
Voting Present--Boyd, Horhn, McMahan, Parker. Total--4.
Senator Polk, who would have voted yea on H. B. No. 1988, announced a pair
with Senator Butler, who would have voted nay.
